mapper.sql: d.dispute_id as disputeId, d.alliance_order_id as allianceOrderId, d.initiator_member_id as initiatorMemberId, d.respondent_member_id as respondentMemberId, d.dispute_type as disputeType, d.dispute_status as disputeStatus, d.claim_amount as claimAmount, d.awarded_amount as awardedAmount, d.frozen_amount as frozenAmount, d.description, d.resolution, d.mediation_deadline as mediationDeadline, d.create_time as createTime, d.update_time as updateTime, o.order_no as orderNo
mapper.select: select from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.alliance_order_id = d.alliance_order_id and a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and a.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.order_id = a.source_order_id and o.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and o.member_id = a.source_member_id and o.is_delete = 0 where d.is_delete = 0 and d.dispute_status = #{status} order by d.create_time desc, d.dispute_id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.alliance_order_id = d.alliance_order_id and a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and a.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.order_id = a.source_order_id and o.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and o.member_id = a.source_member_id and o.is_delete = 0 where d.dispute_id = #{disputeId} and d.is_delete = 0

select evidence_id as evidenceId, member_id as memberId, evidence_type as evidenceType, file_url as fileUrl, file_name as fileName, content, evidence_status as evidenceStatus, create_time as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute_evidence where dispute_id = #{disputeId} and is_delete = 0 order by create_time asc, evidence_id asc

select mediation_id as mediationId, round_no as roundNo, mediator_user_id as mediatorUserId, proposal_amount as proposalAmount, proposal_content as proposalContent, mediation_status as mediationStatus, initiator_confirmed as initiatorConfirmed, respondent_confirmed as respondentConfirmed, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation where dispute_id = #{disputeId} and is_delete = 0 order by round_no desc, mediation_id desc limit 1
